description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You adjust the pigments of your skin, making it difficult to discern details about your body and even determine what parts of your body are where. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] until the beginning of your next turn. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]]. When this effect ends, your skin becomes a mottled mess, so it doesn't blend in with your surroundings.
